name: Xanthic-Dolmen
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by a subterranean ocean, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.

Dense air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Herds of six-limbed graziers shadow the meltwater margins, wary of anything that walks upright.
Nothing about the radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
